purpose: Targeted short-word review to help use the 716 unused revision-27 approvals.
method: Each candidate is independently demonstrated with four currently approved words, including at least one unused approval. Exact seven tiles, five connected answers, at least two long answers, valid crossings/no accidental runs, landscape 6–7 columns and <=5 rows, density 0.35–0.65 and phone-cell-size checks. These are isolated hypothetical examples, not a released or campaign-validated pack.
limitations: Independent examples can overlap in words/wheels and do not establish campaign-wide pacing, the 75-level gap, or a repetition improvement. Only the 54 selected senses are owner-approved; the remaining 46 remain unapproved. Active revision 27 is unchanged. A future content revision must integrate approved vocabulary and validate its campaign together.
sourceAttribution: Individual linked Georgian explanatory-dictionary entries by Linguistic Technologies Group. Concise original English review glosses only; no full dictionary definitions are reproduced.
